nodes.label: gradus-ad-parnassum
nodes.text: RAG over musical notation. Parses scores, annotates them the way a musician would with keys Roman numerals cadences voicing, answers theory questions with measure references. Chopin Etudes corpus, gold questions, eval harness. Long game is notation-native generation grounded in retrieval.

nodes.label: kit-ai
nodes.text: Offline-first emergency first-aid PWA. Llama 3.2 runs on-device through WebLLM and WebGPU, grounded in a vetted knowledge base cached in IndexedDB, keeps working with zero connectivity. Retrieval layer and TTS fallback.

nodes.label: llama3-medical-3b-4bit
nodes.text: Llama 3.2 3B fine-tuned for first-aid question answering, quantized to 4 bits with bitsandbytes. Published on Hugging Face with a demo Space.

nodes.label: accordo
nodes.text: A booking and payments marketplace for musicians. Booking, contracts, payment workflows for working musicians and their clients.

nodes.label: nova
nodes.text: Solana Pay invoicing platform with QR-based crypto payments. Invoices, dashboards, transactions.

nodes.label: subjugator.org
nodes.text: Three.js site for UF's RoboSub team with 3D models of the autonomous submarine. Top RoboSub website, team placed top 15 at RoboSub 2025.

nodes.label: bach-harmonization-judge
nodes.text: Rule-based expert system that scores AI-generated Bach harmonizations against real chorales. Counterpoint, voice leading, doubling rules over MIDI. Judging whether generated music follows the rules.

nodes.label: classical-music-analyzer
nodes.text: Harmonic, motif, rhythm, and instrumentation analysis for MIDI and MuseScore files, with Roman numeral output.

nodes.label: Handtevy
nodes.text: AI engineering intern at Handtevy. Document intelligence pipelines for emergency medicine software used by 200,000+ clinicians. Extraction, retrieval, and eval harnesses for clinical documents that cannot afford to be wrong.

nodes.label: University of Florida
nodes.text: CS student at the University of Florida. Home of the SubjuGator RoboSub team.

nodes.label: Chopin Etudes
nodes.text: Chopin Etudes, the first corpus for gradus-ad-parnassum and core repertoire. Piano performance and practice.

nodes.label: docling #3702
nodes.text: Merged fix for optional-dependency imports that broke docling's core document converter in slim installs. Guarded email and Markdown imports, subprocess regression tests.

nodes.label: docling #3721
nodes.text: Merged code language detection for parsed code blocks in docling documents.

nodes.label: docling boxnote backend
nodes.text: New Box Notes backend for docling, mapping ProseMirror document trees onto DoclingDocument. Headings, tables, rich cells, links. With docling-core mime registration and docling-mcp error handling alongside.

nodes.label: vllm #47439
nodes.text: Fix for response_format silently suppressing tool calls when tool_choice resolves to auto in vLLM's ChatCompletion and Responses APIs. Unit and end-to-end regression tests.

nodes.label: sglang #29952
nodes.text: msgpack round-trip for customized_info in SGLang, removing the pickle wrap and its silent tensor corruption risk.

nodes.label: typescript-sdk #2418
nodes.text: Fix for double onerror on transport close in the MCP TypeScript SDK, ported to v2 with a reconnect fix and regression tests.
